asset.name: Kloofendal Overcast (Pure Sky)
asset.author: Greg Zaal
asset.selectionReason: Sky-only outdoor overcast daylight with soft low-contrast illumination and gentle reflections; avoids foreign interiors, buildings and strong colored ground contaminating house reflections. Retain an authored warm directional key for the sunny reference mood.

validation.method: Decoded all Radiance per-channel RLE scanlines to float32 RGB, checked full byte consumption and provider MD5.

integrationAdvice.imageAssetColorSpace: linear-srgb (HDR source is already linear; renderer detects float RGB and skips gamma decoding)
integrationAdvice.rotationMethod: MotionLoom samples theta=atan2(z,x)+rotationY. The broad upper-sky brightest 1% centroid is aligned approximately toward the source of the existing direction=[.5,-.8,-.65] light, namely [-.5,.8,.65]. Low contrast overcast sky has no hard sun; fine tune rotation from rendered surfaces.
integrationAdvice.lightingAdvice: These are starting points, not visually certified final values. The source upper-hemisphere mean radiance is measured below. Compare the same camera/profile before changing exposure; reduce warm point/window fill if the HDR lifts interiors. Keep the authored warm sun as a separate artistic key and avoid increasing its intensity simultaneously.
integrationAdvice.limitation: Environment lighting is global. This HDR does not add local occlusion, reflection probes or multi-bounce indoor GI.

preview.conversion: linear RGB -> RGB/(1+RGB) -> gamma 1/2.2, downsample to 1024x512. HDR source preserved byte-for-byte.
